title: Lead-Safe Verification Hold
content:
# Lead-Safe Verification Hold

Window Replacement Contracts. The lead-safe verification hold applies while the installation job on the contract's Installation Jobs record is not yet closed: lead-safe work charged on at least 10 openings (the large lead-safe opening count) holds the large lead-safe hold of $200; lead-safe work charged on fewer openings holds the small lead-safe hold of $100; a job with no lead-safe work, or a closed job, holds nothing.

The openings counted are those on the lead-safe fee charges billed on the contract's installation job that is not cancelled. The hold is taken from the job charges collected at payoff.

| Job closed | Openings with lead-safe work charged | Lead-safe hold |
|---|---|---|
| No | 10 or more | $200 |
| No | 1 to 9 | $100 |
| No | None | Nothing |
| Yes | Any | Nothing |

## Hypothetical case

An open job with lead-safe fees charged on 9 openings holds $100; with 10 openings it holds $200; once the job is closed it holds nothing.
